m: उप-भाषा f. a secondary dialect, Dhūrtas.
उप-भैमी ind. besides Bhaimī (i.e. Damayantī), Naiṣ.
उप-√ भू P. (pf. Pot. 2. sg. -बभूयास्; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -भुवस्) to come near to, approach, RV. x, 183, 2; to help, assist, RV. i, 138, 4 : Intens. -बुभूषति, to wish to help, MBh. xii, 3514.
उप-√ भूष् P. -भूषति, to approach (in order to revere), RV. x, 104, 7; to regard, be careful, pay attention to, observe, obey, RV.

m: उप-भूषण n. secondary ornament or decoration
implement.
a: उपभूषणं — A minor or inferior ornament.
उपभंगः — 1 Fleeing away, retreat. --2 A division (of a verse).

उप-√ भज् Ā. (aor. -अभक्त) to obtain, take possession of (acc.), RV. ix, 102, 2.
उप-√ भक्ष्
उप-भक्षित mfn. eaten up, consumed, Suśr.
उप-भेद m. a subdivision, MatsyaP.

a: उपभृत् — f. [उप-भृ-आधारे क्विप्] A round cup used in sacrifices, made of the wood of the banian tree.

k.v: ध्रुवोपभृज्जुहूर्ना तु स्रुवो भेदाः स्रुचः स्त्रियः। उपाकृतः पशुरसौ योऽभिमन्त्र्य क्रतौ हतः॥

m: उप-भृत mfn. brought near, procured for (dat.)
destined to (dat.), BhP.
उपभृतोपशम mfn. one to whom calmness of mind is brought, calm, quiet, BhP. v, 7, 10.

m: उप-भोग m. enjoyment, eating, consuming
using, usufruct, MBh.; Mn.; Śak. &c.
pleasure, enjoyment
enjoying (a woman or a lover), VP.; Ragh. &c.
(with, Jain.) enjoying, repeatedly.
a: उपभोगः — 1 (a) Enjoyment, eating, tasting; न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति Ms. 2. 94, 8. 285; Y. 2. 171. काम˚ Bg. 16. 11; प्रियोपभोग R. 12. 22. (b) Use, application; चरणोपभोगसुलभः Ś. 4. 4. --2 Enjoyment (of a woman), cohabitation; R. 14. 24. --3 Usufruct. --4 Pleasure, satisfaction.

k.v: निर्वेश उपभोगः स्यात्परिसर्पः परिक्रिया। विधुरं तु प्रविश्लेषेऽभिप्रायश्छन्द आशयः॥

m: उप-भोग—क्षम mfn. suited to enjoyment, Śak.
उपभोगिन् mfn. ifc. enjoying, making use of.

v: upa + Buja--Ryat anannArTatve kutvam । upaBogayogye vastuni anne tu na kutvam । upaBojyamityeva । “asUta sA nAgabaDUpaBogyam” kumA॰ । “kiYcitkAlopaBogyAni yOvanAni DanAni ca” paYcata॰ । “viviDAnyannapAnAni puruzA ye'nuyAcinaH । te vE nfpopaBojyAni brAhmaRAnAM daduSca ha” BA॰ ASva॰ 85 a॰ ।
m: उप-भोग्य mfn. to be enjoyed or used
anything enjoyed or used, BhP.; Kum.; Pañcat. &c.
उप-भोग्य n. object of enjoyment, MBh.; Mṛcch.
a: उपभोग्य, --भोक्तव्य, --भोज्य — pot. p. To be enjoyed, used or eaten; Ku. 1. 20; किंचित्कालोपभोग्यानि यौवनानि धनानि च Pt. 2. 114; अस्माकमुपभोग्यो भविष्यति Pt. 1 will become our prey. --ग्यं 1 Any object of enjoyment. --2 Food.

m: उप-भोग्य—त्व n. the state of being enjoyable, R.

v: tri॰ u + Buja--Rini । upaBogakArake । “nivfttAGAraSOcezu parapAkopaBojizu” “ucCinnabaliBikzezu BinnakAMsyopaBojizu” suSru॰ ।
m: उप-भोजिन् mfn. eating, enjoying, Suśr.
उप-भोज्य mfn. ifc. serving for food, causing enjoyment, MBh.
उप-भोक्तृ mfn. one who enjoys or makes use of, an enjoyer, possessor, ŚvetUp.; VarBṛS.
उप-√ भ्रम् P. (pf. -बभ्राम) to saunter or move slowly towards, BhP.

उप-√ 2. भुज् Ā. -भुङ्क्ते, (ep. also -भुञ्जते) to enjoy, eat, eat up, consume, MBh.; Yājñ.; Pañcat. &c.; to enjoy, make use of, partake of; to experience (happiness or misfortune &c.), MBh.; Hariv.; Mn.; BhP. &c.; to enjoy (a woman), Hariv.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.; to receive as a reward, Mn. xii, 8; R. vi, 98, 29 : P. (1. pl. -भुञ्जामस्) to be useful, ChUp. iv, 11, 2 : Caus. -भोजयति, to cause to take (medicine), Suśr.
a: उपभुज् — {c7c} U. 1 To enjoy, taste (in all senses); तपसामुपभुंजानाः फलानि Ku. 6. 10; नोपभुज्यते is not enjoyed, Pt. 2. 142; Ms. 12. 8. --2 To eat, drink; पयः R. 2. 65, 1. 67; Bk. 8. 40; अर्धोपभुक्तेन Ku. 3. 37; Y. 3. 325. --3 To possess; स्त्रीरत्नमुपभुंक्ष्व Hariv. --4 To use, make use of, receive.

m: उप-भुक्त mfn. enjoyed, eaten, consumed
used, possessed &c.
उप-भुक्त—धन mfn. one who has enjoyed or made use of his riches
उप-भुक्त—धन m. N. of a merchant's son, Pañcat. (also in the former meaning).
उप-भुक्ति f. enjoyment, use, T.
(in astron.) the daily course of a star (= भुक्ति, q.v.)
